newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel thinner, but still around.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel thinner, but still around.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run tagged along with crude, bumping prices up by several dollars. The market remained tight with sellers looking for the high $140s fob NWE.

Traders said there was little product available before the end of the month, but conversely there was little buying interest. Russian straight-run was tighter, but still available with an M-100 1.7 percent water selling for $111.50 cif NWE.
In the Med straight-run was tight and low sulphur cargoes should have no difficulty in finding homes. M-40 were very scarce. -- Matthew Jones, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8980
